conduct_political_activity_010.evidence: The Board believes that all of its employees have the right and obligation to be informed and active citizens... The Board feels strongly that its employees have a responsibility to refrain from involvement in political activities during the working day and in the school setting.

conduct_non_duty_hours_011.evidence: The personal life of the teacher or the participation or non-participation in religious, political or teacher association activities of a teacher conducted outside duty hours and off school property shall not be grounds for disciplinary action unless such action is shown to interfere with the regular conduct of the school or schools in Prince George’s County.
